key_features_and_views: Role Switcher (Admin Dashboard / Petugas Mobile View / Public Verification)
Admin - Dashboard Analytics Cards & 7-Day Performance Bar/Line Chart
Admin - Surat Kuasa Management & Multi-Unit Attachment
Admin - Data Akun/Unit Table with Filter, Search, Pagination & Checkbox Bulk Assign
Admin - Penugasan Form & Officer Workload Distribution
Admin - Surat Tugas Generator with A4 Print & Dynamic QR Code Link
Admin - Laporan Petugas Table, Map Location Detail & Evidence Photo Gallery
Petugas - Mobile Home Dashboard (Daily Target, Task Stats & Active Tasks)
Petugas - Detail Tugas View (Unit Specs, Borrower Contact, Address, Map)
Petugas - 3-Step Report Submission Workflow (Outcome -> Camera Photo Evidence -> GPS Location Verification -> Review & Submit)
Public - Surat Tugas QR Code Verification Page (/verifikasi/:id)
Interactive Leaflet/OpenStreetMap Map Component for Visit Locations

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure both Admin Desktop Layout and Petugas Mobile App view operate seamlessly and can be toggled via a top header role bar (Admin View vs Petugas View vs Public Verify).
Use clean Bahasa Indonesia terminology everywhere (Surat Kuasa, Penugasan, Surat Tugas, Laporan Petugas, Ditemukan, Tidak Ditemukan, DPD, Plat Nomor, Leasing, QR Code).
Implement interactive OpenStreetMap (Leaflet or custom vector map component) for viewing visit coordinates in Admin Laporan & Petugas Detail Tugas.
Support camera photo simulation/upload and live GPS geolocation capture in Petugas 3-step report workflow.
Include a dedicated Print A4 Surat Tugas layout with QR Code and legal authorization seal.
Make sure all interactive buttons and navigation items contain explicit data-testid attributes.
